hero.title: Industrial Engineering
hero.description: Trains professionals capable of designing, managing and improving productive and administrative processes, implementing technological innovation to increase organizational efficiency.
hero.supportText: Enroll now and access scholarships and credits

whyStudy.title: Why study Industrial Engineering at CUN?
whyStudy.description: A virtual and flexible training aimed at optimizing processes, technological innovation and improving business competitiveness, with institutional support and SNIES registration.

items.title: Training by propaedeutic cycles
items.description: Obtain three progressive titles: Professional Technician, Technologist and Engineer, which facilitates early job placement.

items.title: 100% virtual mode
items.description: Study from anywhere in Colombia with flexible schedules and an interactive academic platform.

items.title: Focus on innovation and process improvement
items.description: Learn to design, evaluate and optimize productive and administrative systems integrating people, materials and technology.

items.title: Amplios campos laborales
items.description: Performance as a process analyst, production coordinator, quality manager, operational efficiency consultant or industrial project leader.

items.title: Respaldo institucional y registro SNIES
items.description: Program supervised by the Ministry of National Education with resolutions and SNIES records for each training cycle.

items.title: Scholarships and funding
items.description: Advice to access academic, sports and cultural scholarships, and guidance on credits such as ICETEX.

items.title: Virtual platform
items.description: Virtual environment that facilitates autonomous and collaborative learning with interactive materials and activities.

items.title: Academic accompaniment
items.description: Wellness services, internships, and vocational guidance to support your training process.

items.title: Access to scholarships
items.description: Possibilities of scholarships and financial support to facilitate your studies.

items.title: Model 335 - Flexible education
items.description: Modular training that allows you to obtain three degrees and advance through preparatory cycles.

items.title: Study from anywhere
items.description: Virtual mode with flexible schedules and national coverage.
